# 1.2.35 - the screen's factor, a morph that keeps the glass, the grain with the cut, two faces

**The screen's factor.** Every size in the theme is drawn for 2560 x 1440, and
until now that was the only size the module knew: a 1280 x 800 tablet got the
same 330 px notice pane as a 1440p monitor, a quarter of its width. The
interface scale is now the slider times the screen's own factor (the short side
against 1440p, never above 100 %, never under 70 %), recomputed when the window
changes size. A tablet draws at 70 %, a 1080p screen at 75 %, 1440p at 100 %;
the 11 px floor holds the type at every factor, so only the panes shrink. The
Look window shows the screen's factor and the effective one next to the slider.
Measured at 1440p against the audit page: the notice pane 330 px as drawn, the
clock 312 (it is that width now, not "as wide as its longest line"), the
launchers 66.

**The morph.** A state change or a recut used to swap the whole curtain for
flat fills for 840 ms: no texture, no pulse, every pane one colour, and the
panes rounded off on the way because the interpolation dropped their corners
(the "circles floating over the screen"). It is the other way round now. The
new glass is painted at once and stays visible with its texture and its pulse;
a copy of the old glass fades out over it; and only the seams are redrawn each
frame on their way from the old cut to the new, in lead and in the colour on
its way from the old state's to the new. Every vertex is kept, so a pane is a
pane at every frame.

**The grain.** The streaks and veins of a coloured pane ran along one shear for
every pane. Each pane's now lie parallel to its longest edge that is not the
screen's, so the grain follows the cut.

**Two faces.** The base sheet's own font tokens resolve to VT323 under the
theme, and the form controls inside the module's surfaces (a bare `button`
fell to the browser's default face) are the chrome face too. A sweep of every
element on the module's surfaces in the harness reports VT323, Special Elite
and the icon fonts only.
